response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(HGB) * 1.0 / AVG(HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), g AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS gavg FROM p) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS avg_of_avg_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - g.gavg) AS avg_excess FROM p CROSS JOIN g WHERE p.ratio > g.gavg

assumptions.assumption: The all-patient average ratio is the unweighted mean of per-patient ratios, taken over patients whose ratio is non-null (patients with no HGB or HCT values, or zero average HCT, have a NULL ratio and are excluded from that mean and from the kept set).
Patients whose PIC values are all NULL have a NULL avg_pic, which AVG ignores in the final average.
